title: Reading public data

title: Read the open license
reading_goal: I understand that even open-license materials may be subject to attribution requirements or restrictions depending on the terms.
question: What are the terms of an open license?
choices: Conditions such as attribution, whether modifications are permitted, and whether commercial use is permitted
answer: Conditions such as attribution, whether modifications are permitted, and whether commercial use is permitted
explanation: An open license is a license that publicly specifies the terms under which materials may be reused, modified, and distributed. Don’t assume it’s open just because of the word “open”; you must check the specific terms. Be sure to distinguish between whether commercial use is permitted, whether modifications are allowed, whether attribution is required, and whether the work must be shared under the same terms.
